meaning.zh:
“领头地位” 或 “领导者”。

这个短语起源于19世纪，最初是指在比赛或竞争中胜出或占上风的那个人或动物。因此，"top dog" 被用来描述在某特定领域里拥有最高权力或地位的人。
meaning.en: This phrase originated in the 19th century, initially referring to the person or animal that came out on top in a competition or fight. Hence, "top dog" is used to describe someone who holds the highest authority or status in a particular field.

lines.en: In the tech industry, she is considered the *top dog*.
lines.zh: 在科技行业，她被认为是领头人物。

lines.en: After years of hard work, he finally became the *top dog* of the company.
lines.zh: 经过多年的努力，他终于成为公司的领导者。

lines.en: Everyone in the group looks up to him as the *top dog*.
lines.zh: 小组中的每个人都把他当作领头人。
